title: signing: fix the --passphrase-file help text and man pages
body: standalone-sign has no --sign-by flag — the signing identity is the key-fingerprint positional argument — but the --passphrase-file help text and the man page both pointed at --sign-by. The man pages also spell "passphrase" as "passphare" in two places.
